title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 3. Welcomes the Council’s reductions in commitment and payment appropriations as a first, albeit insufficient, step towards budgetary discipline; considers that substantial additional savings remain possible in non-essential, ideological and centralising Union programmes and in administrative expenditure; insists that margins under the MFF ceilings be preserved for genuinely unforeseen needs and that the burden on net-contributing Member States and taxpayers be reduced; stresses that any reinforcement of clearly defined core tasks must be fully financed through redeployment;
